newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco harvests record 9.75 mln tonnes cereals. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Morocco harvests record 9.75 mln tonnes cereals. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]

text.p: Morocco harvested 9.75 million tonnes of cereals in the 1995/96 season, the agriculture ministry said.

"This year, Morocco's total production of main cereals -- hard wheat, soft wheat and barley (corrects to barley from durum) -- reached 97.5 million quintals (9.75 million tonnes)," according to a statement issued by the agriculture ministry on Wednesday.
The ministry said the record harvest beat the previous record of 9.24 million tonnes registered in 1993/1994.
Agriculture Minister Hassan Abou Ayoub earlier announced a provisional figure of 9.57 million tonnes for the 1995/96 season.
"The provisional results are traditionally corrected by taking into account the real yields registered in the different provinces of the kingdom," the statement said.
An area of 5.64 million hectares was sown in 1995/96, similar to the area for 1993/94, it said.

The 1993/94 record followed several years of drought.
Analysts said cereals output in 1994/95, hit by severe drought, was around 1.7 million tonnes.
